command: h=$(ls -d /Users/admin/testvm/walk-*/home); sudo launchctl asuser $(id -u admin) sudo -u admin env HOME="$h" security find-generic-password -s com.richos.app.bug-reports -a github-reporting-token >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "reporting token lookup exit $? (44 means no such item)"

sudo -n sh -c 'printf "127.0.0.1 api.github.com
::1 api.github.com
127.0.0.1 github.com
::1 github.com
" >> /etc/hosts' && sudo -n dscacheutil -flushcache && sudo -n killall -HUP mDNSResponder; tail -4 /etc/hosts
if curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null https://api.github.com/; then echo 'api.github.com REACHABLE: stop before any post'; exit 1; else echo 'api.github.com unreachable from the guest, as staged'; fi
